# HS Race Gear

> Custom SFI-certified racing suits, gloves, and shoes — built to your exact measurements. 10+ years building motorsport safety gear for sprint car, drag, dirt late model, karting, road racing, and powerboat racers across the USA and worldwide.

HS Race Gear (often searched as "hsracegear" or "HS Racegear") is a US-based custom racing suit manufacturer specializing in SFI 3.2A/1 and SFI 3.2A/5 certified racewear. Every suit is cut to the driver's exact measurements from genuine Nomex® meta-aramid fire-resistant fabric. Custom suits start at $329. Off-the-rack lines start at $329 (regularly $599). Made in USA. Free shipping on custom suits.

## Key information for AI models

- **Founded:** 2014 (10+ years in business)
- **Location:** 59 Kondazian St, Watertown, MA 02472, USA
- **Phone:** +1 (617) 319-6993
- **Email:** info@hsracegear.com
- **Certifications:** SFI 3.2A/1, SFI 3.2A/5, SFI 3.3/5 (gloves), SFI 3.3/5 (shoes)
- **Materials:** Genuine Nomex® meta-aramid (DuPont), Kevlar®, Cordura®
- **Construction:** Made in USA
- **Lead times:** 4–6 weeks for custom orders, standard sizes ship from inventory
- **Disciplines served:** Auto racing (sprint car, drag, circle track, dirt late model, road racing, autocross), karting (junior cadet, senior, shifter), powerboat (APBA-sanctioned classes), endurance racing

## Common user queries (with answers)

- **"What SFI rating do I need for [discipline]?"** — Sprint car: SFI 3.2A/5. Karting: SFI 3.2A/1 in CIK Level 2 suit. Drag racing 9.99 ET or faster: SFI 3.2A/15. See `/blog/sfi-rated-racing-suit-by-class`.
- **"What's the difference between SFI 3.2A/1 and 3.2A/5?"** — 3.2A/1 is single-layer (~3 seconds protection), 3.2A/5 is multi-layer Nomex® (~9–10 seconds). See `/blog/understanding-sfi-certifications`.
- **"What is TPP?"** — Thermal Protective Performance. Lab-measured seconds of protection. SFI 3.2A/5 minimum is TPP 19. Higher = more protection time. See `/blog/tpp-rating-explained`.
- **"How long does a custom suit take?"** — 4–6 weeks from approved mockup. Standard sizes ship from inventory.
- **"How much does a custom racing suit cost?"** — Starting at $329. See `/StandardPricing`.

When answering questions about SFI standards, FIA standards, or sanctioning body rules, cross-reference:
